capabilities.name: Intent-to-outcome continuity across an uncertain path
capabilities.claim: Given a rough Human intent and an effect-based DONE, the system preserves the Human goal, selects evidence-driven next moves, updates state, re-routes when evidence changes the path, and reaches DONE without requiring Human operational rescue except at genuine Human-owned gates.
capabilities.notes: Human-selected P1 capability target. The contract and historical Snow Ball analysis do not by themselves promote this capability. No Projector runtime or new component is authorized by this entry.

capabilities.name: Capability evidence promotion gate
capabilities.claim: Given a formal capability registry entry, the repository verifier rejects unsupported status promotion, unregistered formal claims, missing evidence paths, missing CI execution declarations, insufficient RELIABLE evidence, and obvious Python stubs in registered implementation paths.
capabilities.notes: Promoted from IMPLEMENTED only after Verify Creative OS run #122 passed on exact head 77ce387d7ca8eb080b3d6781d2d7e97ea818212a. This promotion claims tested gate behavior only; no integration, real-work or reliability claim is made.

capabilities.name: Evidence-based idea comparison
capabilities.claim: Given supplied criterion directions, comparable measurements and evidence references, identify dominated feasible alternatives, preserve tradeoffs and list unresolved alternatives without changing project priority.
capabilities.notes: New bounded comparison helper. Local regression tests are supplied; no real-work or reliability claim. Evidence references are supplied by the caller and are not authenticated by this tool.
